text:
Emma: Heads-up — customer ticket #8762 complaining their hourly charts are missing data and some hours are shifted by ~3-4h on the console since ~00:30 UTC. Suspect the nightly ETL/backfill. Anyone saw alerts?

Jamal: yup got pager at 00:45, some rollup writes returning 500s, console shows sparse bars for a few tenants. Seeing increased retry queue on the rollup writer. :eyes:

Lina: which backfill? name or job id pls

Emma: etl-rollup-v2-backfill-2026-03-17 (started ~00:00). Dashboard: https://console.redwood.ai/d/rollups/hourly?from=2026-03-17T00:00Z

Priya: looking at infra — K8s shows the backfill controller restarted a pod at 01:12 UTC due to OOM, then the job coordinator rebalanced. Could be partition rebalance + duplicate suppression causing gaps.

Jamal: kafka lag for etl consumer is high. quick check:
```
$ kafka-consumer-groups --bootstrap-server kafka-1:9092 --describe --group etl-rollup-consumer
TOPIC           PARTITION  CURRENT-OFFSET  LOG-END-OFFSET  LAG
rollup-events   0          1245000         5750000         4505000
rollup-events   1          1239000         5748000         4509000
...
```
Lag ~4.5M messages. Writer retries spiked concurrently.

Emma: CS says affected tenants: 8762, 8821, 8890 — charts show holes for hours 02:00-05:00 UTC. They need ETA.

Lina: repro steps for eng to confirm root cause:
1) run this SQL to confirm last processed timestamps:
```
SELECT tenant_id, MAX(processed_at) as last_at FROM hourly_rollups
WHERE tenant_id IN (8762,8821,8890)
GROUP BY tenant_id;
```
2) check kafka offsets for those tenants (topic partition mapping),
3) run backfill in dry-run for the window to verify missing rows.

Priya: FYI we also had a small schema migration at 00:58 that added a 'source_job_id' nullable column to hourly_rollups — migration marked online but one writer crashed while applying indexes. Might interplay with the backfill job.

backfill-bot: Backfill job etl-rollup-v2-backfill-2026-03-17 restarted by Jamal at 01:12 UTC due to OOM. Re-enqueued 1.2M events for reprocessing.

Jamal: I've increased consumer parallelism and bumped the pod replica count to 6. Lag dropped from 4.5M to ~200k in last 6m. ETA to catch up ~40-50m at current throughput. Will keep scaling if needed.

Lina: I'll prepare a targeted backfill for the three tenants to avoid full job re-run. Command (dry-run first):
```
./backfill --tenant 8762,8821,8890 --from '2026-03-17T00:00Z' --to '2026-03-17T06:00Z' --dry-run
# when ready
./backfill --tenant 8762,8821,8890 --from '2026-03-17T00:00Z' --to '2026-03-17T06:00Z' --force
```
(note: --force will write directly; coordinate with CS before running in prod)

Emma: passing ETA to customer: ~45m for initial catch-up, targeted backfill after that if gaps remain. I'll tell them we're doing a targeted run and will confirm once charts refresh.

Priya: action items:
- Jamal: keep scaling consumers, monitor lag and write error rate (pager if >1M lag for 10m).
- Lina: run dry-run, then targeted backfill for tenants above, post results.
- Emma: update CS + include the dry-run output.

Lina: quick note — when running dry-run I saw some rows with processed_at set to a weird epoch (1970) — possible bug in the writer's retry path when partition IDs changed. I'll include a filter to ignore those and surface them in the postmortem.

Jamal: current metrics: consumer throughput ~32k msg/s, errors 0.2% (was 3.4%). UI write latency back to normal.

Emma: Thanks team. I'll keep the ticket open and post back when charts show recovered bars. :thumbsup:

Lina: will update here with dry-run output and backfill job id. ETA ~20m for dry-run.

Priya: set a temporary alert: support-rollup-lag > 1_000_000 for 10m -> pager to eng-oncall.

Jamal: scaling down to 4 replicas now — lag holding constant ~150k.

Emma: customer updated: "appreciate the fast response — please let us know once bars are back".

Lina: Dry-run output snippet:
```
DRY RUN: tenant=8762 missing_hours=3 rows_to_insert=278
DRY RUN: tenant=8821 missing_hours=2 rows_to_insert=184
DRY RUN: tenant=8890 missing_hours=4 rows_to_insert=402
```
I'll kick the targeted backfill (job id backfill-20260317-T-004) now.

backfill-bot: Started targeted backfill backfill-20260317-T-004 by Lina at 02:18 UTC.

Lina: targeted backfill finished. Verifying final writes and clearing stale offsets. Final check SQL shows last_at >= 2026-03-17T06:00Z for all three tenants.

Jamal: console refresh picked up new rows, charts for tenants 8762/8821/8890 look normal now.

Emma: I told the customer it's resolved and closing ticket once they confirm. Thanks all.

Priya: postmortem notes to include: pod OOM during migration, partition rebalance effects on dedupe logic, add safety net alert for backfill restarts and add integration test for partition-shifts.

Lina: adding follow-up: avoid rolling schema+backfill in same window; schedule migration after backfill windows when possible.

Emma: closing loop: customer confirmed charts restored. Thread closed in 2h.
